To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a new generative model for images, the NRM, is proposed; (2) this model yields a new regularized training loss for CNNs; (3) this loss yields a new deep network–the Max-Min network–which outperforms or matches the state of the art for semi-supervised learning on SVHN and CIFAR10, as well as supervised learning on SVH, CIFAR10 and CIFAR100.
we propose the Neural Rendering Model, a hierarchical generative model for images whose inference calculations correspond closely to those in a deep convolutional network.

1) a hierarchical generative model with latent variables and a conjugate prior at each layer can be used for semi-supervised learning, 2) a new regularizer can improve generalization, and 3) the new regularizer and the new loss function can be used for both semi-supervised and fully supervised learning.
